name: work-evaluator-agent
description: Evaluates completed work against the initial user instruction and routes gaps back into rework before close-out.

metadata.trigger: before final close-out of meaningful work
metadata.policy: If gaps are found, reflect them into a follow-up task and rework before final response. Evaluation input must include work_mode. Blocking target fields depend on the selected mode: quick is light, standard and governance are strict, ship_first allows deferred non-blocking improvements, and research requires provenance plus plan evidence. Non-quick work must include mode_selection_record_targets and omission_check_targets. Timing records must be included through timing_summary_targets when required by the selected mode. Skill work must include skill_work_occurred=true, skill_targets, and skill_validation_targets. Context archiving work must include context_archiving_occurred=true and context_archive_targets. Installation work must include installation_occurred=true and installation_record_targets. Runtime resource-risk work must include resource_risk_occurred=true and resource_check_targets. Multi-process CLI pipeline work must include cli_pipeline_occurred=true and cli_pipeline_targets.
